evidence_decisions: Bakauheni 1689 birds: police occurrence date Oct 9; alternate report places interception early Oct 10; retain one event and flag conflicting Jakarta/Yogyakarta destination. Render Palembang–Bakauheni only.
Ketapang: recovery of suspected orangutan skull remains investigative, species and cause/time of death pending; excluded from event/specimen totals.
Bovegno: occurrence month September, exact day unknown; October publication is not occurrence.
Nakonde: seizure before September bribery allegations, exact date unknown; bus destination Lusaka is reported intended movement, no cross-border origin inferred.
Laem Chabang: Oct 7 announcement is not a verified seizure date; Zambia shipment provenance is not poaching origin.
Gaiman and Manglutan: weights are retained separately, never converted into animal counts.
Viana: five animals/items means three live birds plus two parts, not five animals.
Rio Preto: at least four native birds, including one dead; domestic dogs and other mixed domestic/exotic birds excluded from quantity.
Loventue: four heads and three antler sets retained as components without claiming seven deer.
Three multi-location aggregate operations and three equipment/investigative records remain visible but excluded from totals.
No source-photo URL was guessed; new records retain the trilingual unavailable-image fallback.
